fond-uz-patients.title: How FondUz helps people find a medical support program
fond-uz-patients.subtitle: A clear route from a care area to the organization that can help.
content: FondUz brings information about medical support programs together so patients and their families can find relevant organizations more easily.
Before contacting an organization, confirm its eligibility rules and prepare the requested medical records.

patient-support.title: What to prepare before asking for support
patient-support.subtitle: A short checklist for your first conversation with an organization.
content: Prepare current medical summaries, examination results, a phone number where you can be reached, and a short description of your request.
Requirements differ between organizations and programs. Confirm the exact list directly with the organization.

faqs.question: How do I find an organization for my care area?
faqs.answer: Open Care areas, choose a profile, and contact the listed organization to confirm its requirements.

faqs.question: Does FondUz decide who receives funding?
faqs.answer: FondUz helps people find information and contacts. Each organization makes its own support decisions.

faqs.question: Which documents should I prepare?
faqs.answer: Medical summaries and examination results are often requested. Confirm the exact list with the organization you choose.
